subject: 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: The events occur on the 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: Stool
fact: Stool, the myconid, releases his rapport spores.
source_quote: Stool, the myconid, releases his rapport spores.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir peeks outside and observes that it’s very dark.
source_quote: Zalthir peeks outside and observes that it’s very dark.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir plans to sneak into the tower, climb to the top floor, arm himself, and bring weapons back to the prisoners.
source_quote: He plans to sneak into the tower, then quickly climb up to the top floor, arm himself, and bring whatever weapons he can carry back to the prisoners

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is relying on Daz for backup.
source_quote: For backup, he’s relying on Daz.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir trips.
source_quote: Zalthir trips.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir mumbles, 'Get in here and help us?'
source_quote: Zalthir mumbles, 'Get in here and help us?'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir stands up and tries to shove Imbros.
source_quote: Zalthir stands up and tries to shove Imbros as well

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir caresses Imbros instead of pushing him.
source_quote: instead of pushing Imbros, he caressed him.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir tries to strike one of the two drow guards with his unarmed fists.
source_quote: Zalthir tries to strike one of the two drow guards with his unarmed fists.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir again tries to strike Imbros and misses.
source_quote: Zalthir again tries to strike Imbros and misses.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is startled and tries to help Zalthir.
source_quote: Daz is startled and tries to help Zalthir

subject: Daz
fact: Daz kicks the goblet that Zalthir tripped on.
source_quote: Daz is startled and tries to help Zalthir, kicks the goblet that Zalthir tripped on.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz shouts in Thorin’s brain, 'Plan B.'
source_quote: Daz shouts in Thorin’s brain, 'Plan B.'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz focuses his mind on Imbros and speaks the incantation of Mind Sliver.
source_quote: Daz focuses his mind on Imbros and speaks the incantation of Mind Sliver

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remembers how magic missiles work.
source_quote: Daz has recovered from the disastrous opening gambit and remembers how magic missiles work.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz strikes with three magic missiles.
source_quote: It’s not one dart, but three darts.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz strikes with three more magic missiles.
source_quote: Daz strikes with three more magic missiles.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin rushes into the small chamber.
source_quote: Thorin rushes into the small chamber

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin tries to overpower the elite warrior, Imbros.
source_quote: He tries to overpower the elite warrior, whom Sarith identified as Imbros but fails.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is knocked unconscious by Imbros.
source_quote: Imbros strikes Thorin, who falls, bleeding and unconscious.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin slips out of range of the Drow, climbs upstairs, and puts on some armor.
source_quote: Thorin slips out of range of the Drow, climbs upstairs, and puts on some armor.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is healed by Grygum.
source_quote: Grygum stands over the dwarf, and then, with a moment’s incantation and a gentle touch, bloodless flesh becomes rosy, gashes close, and broken bones knit instantly with a rush of magical healing.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is ready to face the world once more after being healed.
source_quote: Flush with renewed vigor, the formerly injured Thorin is ready to face the world once more.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is identified by Sarith as the elite Drow male fighter.
source_quote: whom Sarith identified as Imbros

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is amused by the turn of events and is tempted to kill Thorin.
source_quote: Imbros is, in turn, amused by the turn of events and is tempted to kill Thorin

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros chooses not to kill Thorin because killing prisoners is costly.
source_quote: killing prisoners is a very costly business.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros tries to subdue Thorin and knock him unconscious.
source_quote: So he tries to subdue the dwarf and knock him unconscious.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros deftly dodges Zalthir’s shove.
source_quote: Imbros, trained in Menzoberranzan from a very young age, deftly dodges the attack.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros realizes the revolt has become much more dangerous.
source_quote: Imbros realizes that this revolt has become much more dangerous.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros strikes Thorin, who falls bleeding and unconscious.
source_quote: Imbros strikes Thorin, who falls, bleeding and unconscious.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is unaffected by Mind Sliver.
source_quote: the Drow is unaffected.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros realizes he’s fighting for his life.
source_quote: Imbros now realizes he’s fighting for his life

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros remembers that Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Sarith’s.
source_quote: Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Sarith’s.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros remembers what happened to Drow who failed.
source_quote: he remembers what happened to Drow, who failed.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros strikes Prince Derendil twice using Drow Poison.
source_quote: Imbros strikes Prince Derendil twice; this time, he uses the Drow Poison.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is struck three times by hand-held crossbows.
source_quote: The fellow escapees armed with hand crossbows fire at Imbros, who is struck three times.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is struck by Shuushar’s crossbow bolt.
source_quote: Shuushar aims at Imbros and hits.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros feels the necrotic power of Grygum’s bell but rejects it.
source_quote: Imbros, for a moment, feels the necrotic power consume him but rejects the spell’s powers.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is barely alive but still snarling after magical attacks.
source_quote: Imbros looks battered and barely alive, but he is still snarling.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros stabs Prince Derendil to death.
source_quote: Prince Derendil’s journey ends with being stabbed to death by Imbros.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is cut down by Sarith’s sword.
source_quote: when his sword cuts Imbros down.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith identifies Imbros as the elite Drow male fighter.
source_quote: whom Sarith identified as Imbros

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith curses the Drow guard in a unique way that makes the Drow curse each other.
source_quote: he curses him in a unique way that makes the Drow curse each other.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith suddenly goes mad and is about to scream.
source_quote: Sarith suddenly goes mad. He is about to start screaming at the top of the lungs.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith is calmed by Grygum’s mental guidance.
source_quote: Grygum notices and reaches into Sarith’s mind to tell Sarith to focus on his spirituality and how much better things will be if he chooses to focus his rage on the divine rather than on the material.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith smiles when his sword cuts Imbros down.
source_quote: Sarith smiles, too, when his sword cuts Imbros down.

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil declares he is already armed and wants to kill the Drow.
source_quote: I am already armed in this hideous form, and it would bring me great joy to kill this drow.

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil charges at Imbros.
source_quote: He then charges at Imbros.

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil is injured by Drow Poison.
source_quote: Prince Derendil is injured, and the poison stings.

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil is stabbed to death by Imbros.
source_quote: Prince Derendil’s journey ends with being stabbed to death by Imbros.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum follows his fellow prisoners to the armory.
source_quote: Gyrgum decides that an armed cleric is better than a disarmed cleric and follows his fellow prisoners to the armory.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum descends from the armory and walks towards Thorin.
source_quote: Grygum descends from the armory and walks towards Thorin.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum heals Thorin with a moment’s incantation and gentle touch.
source_quote: Grygum stands over the dwarf, and then, with a moment’s incantation and a gentle touch, bloodless flesh becomes rosy, gashes close, and broken bones knit instantly with a rush of magical healing.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum points his finger at Imbros and casts a bell spell.
source_quote: Grygum points his finger at Imbros, and the dolorous sound of a bell fills the room.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum reaches into Sarith’s mind to calm him.
source_quote: Grygum notices and reaches into Sarith’s mind to tell Sarith to focus on his spirituality and how much better things will be if he chooses to focus his rage on the divine rather than on the material.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum smiles after calming Sarith.
source_quote: Grygum smiles. The lessons of his cult have served him well.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido leads the rest of the prisoners into the chamber.
source_quote: The rest of the prisoners, led by Buppido, take advantage of the distraction, rush into the chamber

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido scrambles into the armory.
source_quote: rush into the chamber, and scramble into the armory.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido attacks from the roof with a hand-held crossbow and misses.
source_quote: Buppido and Jimjar miss.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido makes a wager about reaching Gracklstugh.
source_quote: You should have taken that bet,

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar says, 'You should have taken that bet.'
source_quote: You should have taken that bet,

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar has mastered Spool’s telepathy and forces everyone to listen to him.
source_quote: The Deep Gnome has mastered Spool’s telepathy and forces everyone to listen to him.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth attacks from the roof with a hand-held crossbow and hits the remaining Drow guard.
source_quote: Eldeth and Topsy hit the remaining Drow guard.

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy attacks from the roof with a hand-held crossbow and hits the remaining Drow guard.
source_quote: Eldeth and Topsy hit the remaining Drow guard.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar attacks from the roof with a hand-held crossbow and hits Imbros.
source_quote: Shuushar aims at Imbros and hits.

subject: Ront
fact: Ront squeezes into the fight and strikes the Drow guard, killing him.
source_quote: Ront, who prefers a straight-up fight, squeezes into the fight and strikes at the guard, killing him.

subject: Turvy
fact: Turvy attacks from the roof with a hand-held crossbow.
source_quote: Eldeth, Buppido, Shuushar, Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy attack using hand-held crossbows.

subject: Spool
fact: Spool’s telepathy is mastered by Jimjar.
source_quote: The Deep Gnome has mastered Spool’s telepathy and forces everyone to listen to him.

subject: Drow guards
fact: There are two Drow guards in the chamber.
source_quote: The chamber has two Drow guards and one of the more elite Drow male fighters.

subject: Drow warriors
fact: The Drow warriors are unable to react to the prisoner rush.
source_quote: The Drow warriors are unable to react.

subject: small chamber
fact: The small chamber contains a zurkhwood table and three chairs, a smaller side table, and spider-silk webbing set with hooks for hanging equipment.
source_quote: It contains a zurkhwood table and three chairs, a smaller side table, and spider-silk webbing set with hooks for hanging equipment.

subject: small chamber
fact: The table in the small chamber is set with the Drow game Sava.
source_quote: The table is set with the Drow game Sava.

subject: goblet
fact: The goblet is kicked by Daz and shatters.
source_quote: Daz is startled and tries to help Zalthir, kicks the goblet that Zalthir tripped on. The goblet shatters.

subject: Sava

source_quote: The table is set with the Drow game Sava.

subject: spider-silk webbing

source_quote: It contains a zurkhwood table and three chairs, a smaller side table, and spider-silk webbing set with hooks for hanging equipment.

source_quote: The chamber has two Drow guards and one of the more elite Drow male fighters.

source_quote: The chamber has two Drow guards and one of the more elite Drow male fighters.

subject: No plan survives encounter with the enemy
fact: Zalthir quotes the maxim 'No plan survives encounter with the enemy' from Vof Klownits’s opus.
source_quote: Like the great Sage Vof Klownits described in his opus, an opus that Zalthir never read, 'No plan survives encounter with the enemy.'

subject: Vof Klownits
fact: Vof Klownits is a Sage whose opus contains the maxim 'No plan survives encounter with the enemy.'
source_quote: Like the great Sage Vof Klownits described in his opus, an opus that Zalthir never read
